author_or_account: Patrick Woodworth; Brian Lillie; Paula Glover
title: Public Perception Shifts on Data Center Sustainability
discussion_signal: Public discussion relays Pew findings that data centers are becoming connected to energy-cost concerns, while utility and infrastructure commenters add questions about water, land, pollution, jobs, transmission allocation, and the value proposition offered to host communities.
linked_research_question: When AI infrastructure imposes visible local burdens, what evidence and benefit-sharing arrangements are needed for community consent?
limits: Posts combine survey evidence with industry and advocacy commentary
Local cost claims in comments are not independently validated here
